title: Cross-channel attribution: what it shows and misses

facts.fact: Google's documentation says data-driven attribution is now the default for most conversion actions in Google Ads.
facts.quote: says data-driven attribution is now the default for most conversion actions.

facts.fact: Google Analytics 4 Attribution reports offer three models: data-driven attribution and two last-click models.
facts.quote: lists three models in its Attribution reports: data-driven attribution and two last-click models.

facts.fact: In one geo holdout on streaming TV by Measured's incrementality research, roughly half of the conversions the ad platform had claimed were actually incremental.
facts.quote: roughly half of the conversions the ad platform had claimed were actually incremental.

facts.fact: An incrementality test typically takes several weeks so that it covers the lag between seeing an ad and buying.
facts.quote: a test typically takes several weeks, long enough to cover the lag between seeing an ad and buying.
